# AGENTS.md

VitePress blog for ACM solutions. Authored content lives in the sibling git repo `..\acm-icpc`; this repo only hosts the site. Shell is PowerShell (win32); agents may also run from WSL2 — see WSL notes below.

## Generated files — never edit directly
- `docs/solutions/**`, `docs/solutions/index.md` and `docs/.vitepress/solutionIndex.json` are regenerated by `npm run sync`; manual edits get overwritten.
- To add/update a solution: edit `..\acm-icpc\solutions\<platform_dir>\<name>_solution.md` (optional YAML frontmatter, then the first line must be `# 标题`), then run `npm run sync`.
  - Frontmatter fields (all optional; the file starts directly with `# 标题` if absent):
    - `tags: [树链剖分, 线段树]` — inline array, 1–4 tags from the skill's 标签词表, main algorithm first.
    - `difficulty: "提高+/省选-"` — quoted; Luogu difficulty name, or `"CF 2300"` for Codeforces. Omit if unknown.
    - `source: "https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P3384"` — quoted original problem URL.
  - Written rules and the tag vocabulary live in `.cursor/rules/solution-frontmatter.mdc` and `..\acm-icpc\.skill\SKILL.md`; a new tag word must be added there *and* to `scripts/plugins/tag-dict.mjs`. The parser is plain regex (no YAML dependency).
  - These fields are no longer inert metadata: they drive the article header badges, related solutions, the homepage tag/difficulty sidebar and the search index.
- `docs/.vitepress/problemCache.json` is the committed cache for Luogu difficulty / CF rating lookups (written by the `difficulty` plugin). Delete it to force re-fetching.
- `docs/stats.md` is **hand-written** (not generated): a `layout: page` shell mounting `StatsPage.vue`. `docs/index.md` is the same pattern for `HomeLuogu.vue`.

## Commands (PowerShell)
- `npm run dev` — local preview; open `http://localhost:5173/acm-blog/` (site base is `/acm-blog/`)
- `npm run sync` — `node scripts/sync.mjs`: copies `..\acm-icpc\solutions\*.md` into `docs/solutions/`, runs the plugin pipeline (see below), then writes `docs/solutions/index.md` and `docs/.vitepress/solutionIndex.json`. Override source dir: `$env:ACM_ICPC_ROOT = "D:\code\acm-icpc"; npm run sync`
  - `sync` no longer shells out to `fetch-luogu.mjs`: Luogu account stats are the `luogu-user` plugin, so one `sync` refreshes `HomeLuogu.vue`/`ArticleHeader.vue` too.
- `npm run luogu` — Luogu stats only, no solution sync (thin wrapper over the same plugin). Luogu requires a cookie round-trip (first 302 sets `C3VK`); the script handles it, and warns + keeps existing data if the fetch fails.
- `npm run build` — the only verification step (no lint/typecheck/tests). CI (`npm ci && npm run build`) runs on push to `main` and deploys to GitHub Pages.
- `npm run preview` — serves the built `docs/.vitepress/dist` at `http://localhost:4173/acm-blog/`. It is the only way to test the full-site search index (dev serves a different, unindexed setup). **Restart it after every rebuild** — the static server snapshots its file list at startup, so chunks with a new hash 404 until restart.

## Build-time plugin pipeline (`scripts/`)
- `scripts/sync.mjs` only orchestrates: collect files → run `onSolution` per solution → write `docs/solutions/**` + `index.md` → build `solutionIndex.json` → run `onFinish` per plugin.
- `scripts/lib/` — shared helpers: `fs-utils` (`collectMd`), `markdown` (`h1Of`/`summaryOf`), `category` (`categoryName`), `frontmatter` (`parseFrontmatter`), `http` (fetch with cookie round-trip + retry).
- `scripts/plugins/index.mjs` is the registry: one `[plugin, options]` line per plugin, **comment a line out to disable it**.
- Plugin interface (all hooks optional):
  - `onSolution(sol, ctx, options)` — once per solution; may mutate `sol.meta` / `sol.body`.
  - `onFinish(index, ctx, options)` — once after all solutions; may mutate `index` (the array about to be written) or persist caches.
  - `sol` = `{ rel, dir, full, raw, body, meta }` (`rel` is relative to `solutions/`); `ctx` = `{ blogRoot, acmRoot, srcDir, dstDir, dataDir, log, warn, solutions }`.
  - A throwing plugin only logs a warning; it never aborts the sync. Network plugins must fall back to existing data.
- Registered plugins: `frontmatter`, `infer-meta` (tags inferred from `**算法类型**` only when `tags` is missing, output limited to the dictionary), `problem-link` (infers `source` for luogu/cf/agc only), `difficulty` (Luogu 9-level name / CF rating, cached in `problemCache.json`), `git-date`, `collapse-code` (wraps `## 参考代码` in `::: details 点击展开参考代码`), `luogu-user`.
- `solutionIndex.json` entries carry `title`, `id`, `category`, `link`, `summary`, `date`, `tags`, `difficulty`, `difficultyColor`, `source`; absent values are omitted.

## WSL2 (Linux) agent notes
- WSL paths: this repo `/mnt/c/Users/13368/Desktop/acm-blog`, source repo `/mnt/c/Users/13368/Desktop/acm-icpc`.
- `npm run sync` / `npm run luogu` work from WSL (pure Node, cross-platform).
- `npm run build` fails from WSL: `node_modules` is Windows-installed (missing `@rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu`). Never reinstall `node_modules` from WSL — it breaks the Windows install. Verify builds on Windows or rely on CI.
- WSL git has no credential helper; `git push` fails with `could not read Username for 'https://github.com'`. Push via Windows git instead (uses Windows Credential Manager): `"/mnt/d/Git/cmd/git.exe" -C "C:\Users\13368\Desktop\acm-blog" push origin main`. Windows git is at `D:\Git\cmd\git.exe`, not `C:\Program Files`.
- Network git commands go through a local HTTP proxy pinned in the **global** git config: `http.proxy` / `https.proxy` = `http://127.0.0.1:7897`. If the proxy app is not running, or the configured port drifts from the port it actually listens on, every network git command fails with `Failed to connect to github.com port 443 via 127.0.0.1 after ... ms: Could not connect to server` — that is a proxy problem, not a GitHub outage, so retrying does nothing. Check the real listening port (`Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort <port> -State Listen`) and fix the default with `git config --global http.proxy http://127.0.0.1:<port>` (mirror it for `https.proxy`); for a one-off, override with `git -c http.proxy=... -c https.proxy=... push`. Verify without pushing: `git ls-remote origin HEAD`.
- Line endings are pinned to LF by the root `.gitattributes` (`* text=auto eol=lf`). Windows git has `core.autocrlf=true` while WSL git does not, so with no attributes a WSL `git add` stores CRLF blobs and the two gits disagree about what is modified. Never "fix" a repo-wide modified list by committing it: check `git ls-files --eol` first, then `git add --renormalize .`. The same file is in the sibling repo `..\acm-icpc`; keep both identical.
- If a Pages deploy run is stuck `queued` for hours, push an empty commit (`git commit --allow-empty`) to trigger a fresh run; watch `https://github.com/Pixel-fish-123/acm-blog/actions`.

## Commit rules
- Commit only `docs/` changes, `scripts/` changes, `AGENTS.md`/`README.md` edits, plus `package.json`/`package-lock.json`. `docs/stats.md`, `docs/index.md` and `docs/.vitepress/problemCache.json` are tracked files, not generated output.
- `.cursor` is gitignored in this repo, so plans/rules stay local. Push to `main` auto-deploys (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`).

## Architecture gotchas
- `docs/.vitepress/config.mjs`: `appearance: false` must stay at the top level (not inside `themeConfig`) or the dark-mode toggle reappears. `base` is `/acm-blog/` (env `VITEPRESS_BASE` overrides); matches repo name — update both if renamed.
- `date` in `solutionIndex.json` is the **first commit that added the file** (`git log -1 --diff-filter=A --format=%cs`), not the last one, so a bulk edit no longer collapses every date to one day. The pathspec must keep the `solutions/` prefix (`sol.rel` is relative to `solutions/` while git runs in `acmRoot`); otherwise git silently returns an empty string with exit code 0 and the plugin would fall back to mtime. The article header's "更新于" is a different thing: VitePress `lastUpdated`, i.e. last commit time.
- Homepage profile data lives in the `luogu` constant at the top of `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/HomeLuogu.vue` — auto-refreshed by `npm run sync` via the `luogu-user` plugin (can still be edited manually); list/tags are driven entirely by `solutionIndex.json`.
- Homepage filtering lives in `docs/.vitepress/theme/filters.js` (pure functions: `parseFilters` / `toQuery` / `matches` / `sortItems` / `collectTags` / `difficultyStats`) plus `SolutionFilter.vue`; `HomeLuogu.vue` owns the state and mirrors it to `?q=&cat=&tag=a,b&diff=&sort=` with `history.replaceState` (read back on mount). Tag/difficulty are picked from the sidebar cards, not the filter bar; tags are AND-ed. `difficultyStats` must emit Luogu tiers → CF ratings ascending → unknown labels → unlabelled, or CF-only difficulties silently disappear from the sidebar.
- Category labels come from `categoryName()` in `scripts/lib/category.mjs` — new platform directories must be mapped there.
- Theme wiring is slot injection in `docs/.vitepress/theme/index.js` (`nav-bar-content-after` → NavLuogu, `doc-before` → ArticleHeader, `doc-after` → RelatedSolutions).
- `docs/.vitepress/theme/solution.js` maps the current page's `relativePath` (`solutions/luogu/P3384_solution.md`) back to a `solutionIndex.json` entry via its `link`; `ArticleHeader.vue`, `RelatedSolutions.vue` and `config.mjs`'s search `_render` all use that convention and render nothing on non-solution pages (homepage, index).
- `docs/solutions/index.md` is only a shell (`layout: page`) mounting `SolutionIndexPage.vue`; the grouped list plus the right-hand tag filter live in that component, so the index page body is not covered by local search.
- Article width is capped by VitePress's `.VPDoc .container { max-width: 992px }`, not by `.content`; `custom.css` overrides `.VPDoc .container.container.container` to 1180px. Code blocks inside `::: details` shrink to 12.25px unless `.custom-block` is reset away from VitePress's 14px `--vp-custom-block-font-size`.
- `npm run sync` wipes and recreates `docs/solutions/`; with a dev server running that can kill its watcher (dev exits — restart it). `npm run build` writes `docs/.vitepress/dist/` inside the watched root, which makes dev log a `page reload` for every built page (noisy but it survives). Prefer running `sync` and `build` before starting dev.
- MathJax is on (`markdown.math: true`); `$...$` must be balanced or formulas render as source.

### Full-site search (`themeConfig.search` in `config.mjs`)
- MiniSearch's default tokenizer splits on whitespace/punctuation, so Chinese is unsearchable; `cjkTokenize` emits lowercased ASCII words plus CJK bigrams. Indexing and querying must use the same tokenizer.
- VitePress serializes functions in site data (`serializeFunctions` → `_vp-fn_…` → `new Function` on the client), so `tokenize` survives — **but only if it is self-contained**: no closure variables, imports or `this`, or the client-side copy breaks while the build still succeeds.
- Keys starting with `_` are skipped by that serializer. `_render` relies on this: it is build-time only and may use Node APIs (`fs`, `path`).
- `_render` receives markdown that `processIncludes` has **already stripped the frontmatter from** — `env.frontmatter` is empty. Tags therefore come from `solutionIndex.json` (found by walking up from `env.path`), which also covers tags inferred by `infer-meta` instead of written in frontmatter.
- `_render`'s return value feeds only `splitPageIntoSections`; it is never written into page HTML (the injected `<p hidden id + tags>` is index-only, so it cannot show up on a page).
- `npm run dev` does not serve the production search index; verify search with `npm run build` + `npm run preview`.

## Conventions
- Luogu style: no shadows, 4px radius, no emoji, no new dependencies.
- Editing `config.mjs` restarts the dev server fully (10–30 s cold start); component/CSS edits are fast HMR.
